renderer: pinned patched projectM-TV source34, macOS GLES + SwiftShader (native ruler), 480x270, mesh 48x32, checkpoint PCM
orientation: native-ruler .rgb.u8 frames are written top-down (native-ruler.cpp reverses glReadPixels rows); the full r8 render matches the emulator screenshot at image correlation 0.969 as stored vs 0.761 flipped
correction: policy v1 (commit e45e6959) read the ruler frames flipped vertically, which inverted every vertical conclusion; v2 repeats all probes on correctly oriented frames
method: each probe seeds texture in the first frames, then isolates one motion term; the illustrator's backward map (from the exported mesh_field facts) is applied to native frame 6 and correlated with native frame 7 (20 px margin)

procedural_warp_formula.result: in the y-down frame the warp shader path uses pos.y = +down with u+=du, v+=dv; presets without a warp shader compile PROJECTM_LEGACY_WARP (pos.y enters with the opposite sign). Each path reaches 0.9987 with its own formula and about 0.46 with the other; the pre-session map reached 0.53/0.41.

mesh.result: motion evaluated at the 48x32 vertices, mesh row 0 at the top edge, interpolated over the engine triangulation (0.9987 vs 0.9966 for the mirrored row order on both warp probes)

blur_orientation.probe: blur-comp: composite ret=GetBlur1(uv) over a patch seeded at uv_orig.y>0.7 (the bottom-left of the screen)
blur_orientation.result: flipud(blur_bank(top-down image)) reproduces the native GetBlur1 display to 6e-5 mean abs error

blur_timing.result: warp output changes every second frame (blur made from the previous buffer, updated after a blur-sampling warp); composite shows blur from frame 1 (previous canvas)

builtin_wave_orientation.result: wave near the top; screen row = (1-y)/2*H for built-in wave NDC y, matching to the pixel; per-frame light 469 vs 470 luma units

custom_wave_and_shape_orientation.result: custom-wave points (r8 star field) correlate 0.961 with the existing mapping (y=1 at the top) and 0.058 mirrored; a shape at y=0.8 renders 20% down from the top (shape-wave-orient probe)

conventions_top_down_screen.motion: y down (MilkDrop y=0 at the top): u_src=u-dx, v_src=v-dy, rotation u'=du*cos-dv*sin, v'=du*sin+dv*cos about (cx, cy); per-pixel y=0 at the top; ang=-atan2(y_down-0.5, x-0.5) (unchanged from the pre-session map, all 1.000)
